Container.Name: My-Audiobook-Collection
Container.Overview: Browse and play your audiobook collection, organised as Genre / Author / (Series) / Book. Reads MP3 metadata, fills gaps from the Google Books API and remembers the playback position per user.

Config.Name: Import folder
Config.Description: Where new audiobooks arrive, to file with Import

Config.Name: Admin password
Config.Description: Guards everything that changes the collection. This is the only place it is set. Leave empty for an install nobody has to unlock.

Config.Name: Google Books API key
Config.Description: Used to look up missing metadata. This is the only place the key is set.

Config.Name: User ID
Config.Description: The user the app writes as. 99 is nobody on Unraid, which owns your shares — leave it, or folders it creates belong to root and you cannot write in them.

Config.Name: Group ID
Config.Description: The group the app writes as. 100 is users on Unraid.

Config.Name: File mode mask
Config.Description: 000 makes the folders and files it creates writable by everyone on the share, which is what Unraid shares normally are. 022 makes them read-only to others.
